_comment: Reference results from our test bench. Verified 2026-04-20. Latency numbers will differ on your machine; the NaN/total ratios should match.

00_demonstrate_strobe_int8.model: SD Turbo UNet INT8 (GenAI-SD reference, AMD custom ops)
00_demonstrate_strobe_int8.observation: ~50/50 NaN/clean alternation at every sleep level
00_demonstrate_strobe_int8.interpretation: deterministic per call parity, not a timing race

01_verify_fix_fp32.model: SD Turbo UNet fp32 (raw export, no replaced custom ops)

summary.shipping_choice: fp32 + vaiml_compile_v4 (3-5x latency vs INT8, zero corrupted frames)
